t: Today a friend called from northern Somalia. His son, who had actually just married, went on takhrib. He was caught in Libya by “magafe”. Now the father shall pay ransom (sth around 15.000 USD). I have to say: Takhrib is a disaster on so many levels, and much of the bad things about it are known. Wh
exp: This post describes a personal anecdote about a friend's son who engaged in 'takhrib' (a term that can refer to destructive acts or illegal migration, often associated with human trafficking in this context) and was caught by 'magafe' (a term for human traffickers or smugglers). The post expresses concern about the disaster of 'takhrib' and the ransom situation. It is a personal account and commentary on a social issue, not hate speech.
